turns.question: How much did bookings grow in the week of 14 September 2026 compared with the previous week?
turns.answer: Bookings grew 27.3% (a growth share of 0.273) in the week of 14 to 20 September 2026 compared with the week before. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
